title: mail-server canonical history: Mailbox/Identity/VacationResponse, register_mail_handlers_with_history, memory backend
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H4. Crates: jmap-mail-types (src/backend.rs), jmap-mail-server, root AGENTS.md. Size: L.

Spec: object-history-03 §3, §4, §5.1, §5.2, §8.2. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 ('Opt-in without touching plain handlers', 'Registration'), §6, §7, §9 'Existing crates'.

This is the canonical shape that every sibling crate copies.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for Mailbox, Identity, VacationResponse in mail-types (Email and SieveScript come in H5/H6).
- Move each handle_<x>_set body into a private <x>_set_impl<B, R: RestoreStage<B>>. NoRestore keeps the plain bytes; WithRestore runs run_restore_phase. Mailbox uses parent-first restore order.
- Add history /get, /set, and Mailbox /query and /queryChanges handlers.
- register_mail_handlers_with_history calls register_mail_handlers, then re-registers through Dispatcher::register_history_aware. Bind `using` from CallContext where the plain registration has none.
- Memory: ObjectHistoryBackend for MemoryBackend through MemoryBackend::with_object_history(capability, retention), off by default.
  - VersionLog lives in Inner, so conditional ScopedState rollback covers it.
  - Record every update and destroy; the private ChangeType gains Restored, folded with OHS fold_restore.
  - Destroyed-query state carries a private kind prefix (decision 6(c)); rights_changed_at per Mailbox.
  - test-helpers knobs: set_history_clock_for_test, discard_version_for_test, purge_object_history, set_rights_changed_at_for_test.
  - Debug-assert that supported_types only lists is_history_type names.
- Add an 'object-history opt-in pattern' section to root AGENTS.md: separate trait, _with_history, call register_<x>_conditional after it.
- Registry cross-check test: every HistoryObject impl satisfies is_history_type.

Acceptance:
- Restored id in Mailbox/changes is updated or created, never destroyed.
- Ids are never reused; restoring a current id ⇒ notFound; final version discarded ⇒ notFound for get, query and restore (decision 6(d)).
- Parent and child Mailbox restore in either key order.
- §8.2 cut hides versions from before a rights change.
- VacationResponse restore ⇒ notFound.
- Plain register_mail_handlers bytes unchanged (snapshot tests).
- public-api, README/PLAN, CHANGELOG bullet.
